evidence.why: Only the publishable key is used in client code, which is the intended public key, not a secret.
Secret key is read server-side without a public prefix, never reaching the browser.

controls_present: Secret key read only in server-only module (app/lib/stripe.ts)
Checkout session creation happens in server route handler, authenticated via getServerSession
Client only uses publishable key and session id/url returned from server
